entities.name: Dello di Niccolò Delli
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dello di Niccolò Delli, also known as Dello Delli, Dello di Niccolò and Dello, was an Italian sculptor and painter from Florence. His father was a tailor named Niccolò di Dello. Painters Nicola Delli and Sansone Delli were his less famous younger brothers.
